orders.thesis: Marathon Petroleum hit a fresh 52-week high as WTI crude spiked +6% on renewed US-Iran tensions. Refining margins widen when oil moves sharply — MPC is the purest US refining play with top-tier crack spread exposure. Forward PE 11.7x with 1.5% yield. The geopolitical oil premium is unlikely to reverse within our 10-day horizon.
